description: Additional placeholder-resolution coverage: two adjacent env placeholders concatenated with no separator, a section scalar overriding a common scalar, a common-only variable inherited into a section that supplies its own templates, and a file include whose nested mapping is recursively merged with a section-level override of the same key. Output is the resolved section as sorted JSON.

input.config:
common:
  glued: "{{ env='A_VAR' }}{{ env='B_VAR' }}"
concat:
  templates:
    - template: t.yaml.j2

common:
  k8s_namespace: shared_ns
  replicas: 1
override_scalar:
  replicas: 5
  templates:
    - template: t.yaml.j2

common:
  k8s_namespace: shared_ns
  shared_flag: enabled
inherits:
  own_var: local
  templates:
    - template: t.yaml.j2

common:
  conf: "{{ file='frag.yaml' }}"
merge_include:
  conf:
    router:
      port: 9090
  templates:
    - template: t.yaml.j2
